# Select

Choose a value inside a list.
See [Select guidelines<i className="ds-icon-launch"></i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/select/design/)

### When to use

The `Select` component is designed to be used in forms to select a single value from a list of options and submit data.

Use the <LinkTo kind="Components/ComboBox" story="docs">ComboBox</LinkTo> when there is a large list of options to choose from.

<Source code="import { Select } from &#x22;@airbus/components-react&#x22;" />

<Primary />

<Controls />

* Any other props supplied will be provided to the `<select>` HTML element
* For details on CSS styles, see [CSS implementation](https://github.airbus.corp/Airbus/design-system/blob/develop/packages/styles/src/elements/Select/index.ts)

## Modes

You can choose from three different modes
* **NATIVE**: native HTML `<select>`. The appearance will depend on browser.
* **CUSTOM**: custom HTML component based on <LinkTo kind="Components/ComboBox" story="basic">ComboBox</LinkTo>. The appearance will be unified.
* **AUTO (default)**: default to `CUSTOM` with automatic fallback to `NATIVE` on touch devices.

<Canvas of={SelectStories.Modes} />

### Grouped Options

Using `groupBy` method will group options with native html `<optgroup>` elements.<br />
Use the <LinkTo kind="Components/ComboBox" story="grouped-options">ComboBox</LinkTo> component for more advanced use cases.
